iceburncustom.name: Ice Burn (Custom)
iceburncustom.desc: The user fires an ice-cold beam of tremendous power. The target has a 50% chance to be burned or a 50% chance to be frostbitten. The user must recharge next turn.
iceburncustom.shortDesc: 180 BP; user must recharge; 50% burn / 50% frostbite.
